set.prevailing_wage_basis: Labor Code 1720(a)(1) reaches only construction paid for in whole or in part out of public funds, and 1720(c)(1) exempts private residential projects on private property unless built under an agreement with a state agency, redevelopment or successor agency, or local public housing authority; the inclusionary ordinance (Zoning Ordinance 6341) and density bonus (7430) provide density and processing incentives only (Applicant Guide, Incentives section) and pay no public funds, so they do not by themselves trigger prevailing wage. County funds layered on a project are tested separately. https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720

reason: Regulatory program with density and processing incentives only; no public funds under 1720(b).
